primer: Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd (NSE: JYOTICNC ) is India's largest domestic maker of simultaneous 5-axis CNC machines . It holds roughly 8% to 10% of India's overall CNC market. The company serves Aerospace & Defence, Automotive, General Engineering, and Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) from Rajkot and France . As of September 30, 2026, it holds a ₹5,082 Cr order book and delivered 28% standalone EBITDA margins in Q2 FY27 .
